text: {"assertions":["A hang on exit bug was discovered in cli/commands/deploy.py that only occurred with deeply nested inputs beyond six levels.","The root cause of the hang on exit issue was a mutable default argument being shared across multiple function calls.","The fix involved replacing the mutable default argument with an empty default and building the value per call, submitted as PR #3327 on branch fix/hang-on-exit-1.","The error rate for the deploy command improved from 8.1 percent to under 0.06 percent (6 per ten thousand) after the fix was applied.","The hang on exit fix was applied to the same area of cli/commands/deploy.py where an earlier hang on exit issue had been previously addressed."]}
